title: Northbeam TechWorks Receivables Instruction: Labour, Travel and Settlement
content:
This instruction states how a charge on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job is arrived at and when it may be booked at all.

## 1. Chargeable labour

Chargeable labour is the hours actually worked, rounded up as the service's rounding basis states, times the service's hourly rate. The words raising that quantity to the service's minimum hours are **no longer in force**, having been superseded by the current basis on which a minimum is applied; the rest of this clause stands, and the service's own rounding basis and hourly rate are read as they stand for the TechWorks service the job is handled under.

## 2. When labour may be billed and a payment applied

Labour is billed, and payments applied, only while the agreement stands dispatched, held for parts or completed. The state is read from the work order before the charge or the payment is booked, against the agreement the entry names.

| The job stands | Labour billed | Payment applied |
| --- | --- | --- |
| asked for | no | no |
| booked | no | no |
| dispatched | yes | yes |
| held for parts | yes | yes |
| completed | yes | yes |
| called off | no | no |
| recorded as a failed attendance | no | no |

## 3. Bringing the crew out

The crew attendance charge of the service is billed once per visit and is waived where the labour and parts on that visit reach the service's waiver figure. A return visit after a hold for parts carries no second crew attendance charge.

## 4. Distance

Mileage beyond the service's covered radius is billed at the service's rate for each mile beyond it, measured from the service point to the address.

## 5. Mounting

Mounting to a wall other than drywall on studs carries the surcharge the service's wall type mapping gives for that construction, and brackets and fixings are billed separately unless the service includes them.

## 6. Settlement

A business account settles within the service's payment terms, and a consumer account settles on the day. A payment is applied to the oldest unsettled charge first.

## Points of judgement

**A charge on a job that has been called off.** Clause 2 allows labour and payments in three states only. A job called off stands in none of them, so no labour is billed on it under this instruction and no payment is applied to it.

**Two visits on one job, one hold for parts between them.** Clause 3 bills the crew attendance charge once per visit but denies a second charge for the return after a hold for parts, so the job carries one such charge across the two attendances.

The per-service figures this instruction reads — the hourly rate, the minimum hours, the rounding basis, the crew attendance charge and its waiver figure, the covered radius, the per-mile charge, the wall type mapping, whether brackets and fixings are included, the items allowed in one visit, the payment terms and the ways charges may be settled — are carried in the labour, attendance, mounting and settlement schedules for the six TechWorks services.

superseded_clauses: raised to the service's minimum hours
